title: Tron Inc. Super Representative Node Rises to Number 1 Rank on TRON Network
summary: Winter Park, Florida, Oct. 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Tron Inc. (Nasdaq: TRON), the largest publicly traded holder of TRON (TRX) tokens, today provided an update on its TRON network integration initiatives. Strong community support in token delegation has elevated the company’s Super Representative (SR) node to No. 1 in the current rankings, with approximately 3.71 billion delegated TRX tokens as of October 21, 2026, underscoring rapid growth since its official SR election earlier this month.
